description: Test suite for audit-seams functionality, which involves analyzing source files to detect specific seam classifications and their statuses in a project related to cron and subagent orchestration. The tests import source snippets and call functions like describeSeamKinds and determineSeamTestStatus to verify seam detection logic.

methods.name: runCronIsolatedAgentTurn
methods.description: Simulates the cron agent turn, registering context, performing fallback run, delivering payloads, and building session context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the cron service, loading state, recomputing next runs, persisting state, arming timer, and running missed jobs. Returns next run time.

methods.name: spawnSubagentDirect
methods.description: Spawns a subagent, calls gateway, registers subagent run, deletes session, emits spawn event, and returns response.

methods.name: completeRun
methods.description: Completes a subagent run, resolving context, capturing reply, emitting end hook, persisting state, and announcing flow.

methods.name: startAcpSpawnParentStreamRelay
methods.description: Sets up a parent stream relay for ACP spawn, listening to agent events, requesting heartbeat, and enqueueing system event.
